extracted.intended_audience: researchers, students, policy analysts, and general readers seeking country factbook-style reference profiles
extracted.subtask_description: Create or evaluate a country factbook–style reference entry that summarizes a country's Background, Geography, People, Government, Economy, Communications, Transportation, Military, and Transnational Issues with standardized data fields and brief narrative notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Background
rubrics_metrics.description: A brief historical and contextual overview summarizing major events shaping the country's recent history (e.g., independence, colonial period, unification/secession, major conflicts, political turning points).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include key dates and events (independence, unification, major wars or secessions), descriptions of colonial/foreign involvement, major political shifts, and remarks on strategic location or regional relationships. Example language on page: 'North Yemen became independent... South Yemen... unified as the Republic of Yemen in 1990.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard geographic facts and notes including map references, location, area and comparative area, land boundaries, coastline, maritime claims, climate, terrain, elevation extremes, natural resources, land use, irrigated land, natural hazards, and environment issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide: 'Map references', 'Location/Geographic coordinates', 'Area (total/land/water)', 'Area - comparative', 'Land boundaries (total and border countries)', 'Coastline', 'Maritime claims (territorial sea, EEZ, continental shelf)', 'Climate', 'Terrain', 'Elevation extremes (highest/lowest)', 'Natural resources', 'Land use (arable/permanent crops/other)', 'Irrigated land', 'Natural hazards', 'Environment - current issues', and optional 'Geography - note' with notable facts. Use precise numeric values where available and short explanatory notes (e.g., percent water/land, climate regions).

rubrics_metrics.name: People (Demographics)
rubrics_metrics.description: Demographic and social statistics including population totals, age structure, population growth, birth and death rates, sex ratio, infant mortality, life expectancy, fertility, HIV/AIDS data, religions, languages, and literacy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include: 'Population' (with date/estimate), 'Age structure' (percent and counts if available), 'Median age', 'Population growth rate', 'Birth rate', 'Death rate', 'Net migration rate', 'Sex ratio' (by age groups and total), 'Infant mortality rate' (total and by sex), 'Life expectancy at birth' (total and by sex), 'Total fertility rate', 'HIV/AIDS statistics' (prevalence, PLWHA, deaths), 'Religions' (percent breakdown), 'Languages' (major languages with percents), and 'Literacy' (definition and percent by sex). Provide years for estimates and note data gaps (NA).

rubrics_metrics.name: Government (Political/Administrative)
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on formal country identifiers and political institutions: country name forms, government type, capital, administrative divisions, independence/constitution dates, legal system, suffrage, executive/legislative/judicial branches, political parties and leaders, political pressure groups, international organization participation, diplomatic representation, and flag description.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide standardized fields: 'Country name' (conventional long/short/local), 'Government type', 'Capital', 'Administrative divisions (names/count and notes)', 'Independence' date, 'National holiday', 'Constitution' (date/amendments), 'Legal system', 'Suffrage' (voting age), 'Executive branch' (chiefs, selection, cabinet), 'Legislative branch' (structure, seats, elections), 'Judicial branch', 'Political parties and leaders', 'Political pressure groups', 'International organization participation' (list), 'Diplomatic representation in/from US' (mission/chief, contact info), and 'Flag description'. Include election results or composition notes where available and indicate NA where not reported.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy
rubrics_metrics.description: An overview plus standardized economic indicators: GDP (PPP and growth), GDP per capita, sector composition, investment, poverty, income distribution, inflation, labor force, unemployment, budget and public debt, major agricultural and industrial products, energy (electricity/oil/natural gas), trade (exports/imports and partners), reserves, external debt, economic aid, currency and exchange rates, and fiscal year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a short 'Economy - overview' narrative and numeric fields: 'GDP' (PPP and growth rate), 'GDP - per capita', 'GDP - composition by sector', 'Investment (gross fixed)', 'Population below poverty line', 'Household income or consumption by percentage share', 'Gini index', 'Inflation rate', 'Labor force' and 'by occupation', 'Unemployment rate', 'Budget (revenues/expenditures)', 'Public debt', 'Agriculture - products', 'Industries', 'Industrial production growth rate', 'Electricity production/consumption/exports/imports', 'Oil production/consumption/exports/imports/proved reserves', 'Natural gas stats', 'Current account balance', 'Exports/Imports (values, commodities, partners)', 'Reserves of foreign exchange & gold', 'Debt - external', 'Economic aid - recipient', 'Currency/name/code', 'Exchange rates (historic series if available)', and 'Fiscal year'. Use dates/estimates and indicate NA where data missing. Short narrative may contextualize IMF programs, donor packages, or structural reforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Telecommunications and media statistics and system descriptions: fixed/main telephone lines, mobile cellular subscriptions, assessment of telephone system, radio and television broadcast stations, counts of radios/televisions, internet country code, ISPs, internet hosts/users.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include counts and dates for 'Telephones - main lines in use', 'Telephones - mobile cellular', 'Telephone system' (general assessment, domestic, international links and country code), 'Radio broadcast stations (AM/FM/shortwave)', 'Radios (units)', 'Television broadcast stations', 'Televisions (units)', 'Internet country code', 'Internet hosts', 'Internet Service Providers (ISPs)', and 'Internet users'. Note infrastructure links (satellite earth stations, microwave, GSM) and any national network development comments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation
rubrics_metrics.description: Transport infrastructure data including railways, highways, ports and harbors, pipelines, merchant marine, and airports (counts and runway types).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide standardized fields: 'Railways' (total and gauge breakdown), 'Highways' (total/paved/unpaved), 'Pipelines' (oil/gas lengths), 'Ports and harbors' (principal ports), 'Merchant marine' (total ships and types), 'Airports' (total and number with paved/unpaved runways by runway length categories). Use year estimates and indicate NA where unavailable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military
rubrics_metrics.description: Basic military and defense statistics: military branches, manpower (availability, fit for service, reaching military age annually), conscription/obligation, military expenditures (dollar figure and percent of GDP), and short notes on noteworthy defense developments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include 'Military branches' list, 'Military manpower' (age ranges and counts for availability and fit for service), 'Military manpower - reaching military age annually', 'Military age and obligation' (conscription age/length), 'Military expenditures' (dollar and percent of GDP), and a short 'Military - note' for context (e.g., establishment delays, force composition). Provide dates for estimates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transnational Issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Cross-border and international-issue notes such as international disputes, refugee/IDP situations, illicit drugs metrics, international environmental agreements, and other issues that cross national boundaries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include 'Disputes - international' (claims, cease-fires, unresolved sovereignty, boundary/territorial disputes), 'Illicit drugs' (production, eradication, seizures, consumption estimates), 'Refugees and internally displaced persons' where present, 'Environment - international agreements' participation, and any notes on transnational resource/territorial conflicts. Provide concise factual summaries and dates/estimates.
